title: Marie's Room
description:
CHECK OUT OUR SECOND TITLE  
 
  JOIN THE COMMUNITY  
 
  About the Game  Marie's Room is a short story exploration game about an unconventional friendship between two classmates. You play as Kelsey, remembering Marie's room as it was twenty years ago. But something’s off. What happened to Marie? 
 
  “There was nothing I could do about the past. It was definite as hell.” - Kelsey 
 
 Kelsey has come back to a room packed up in boxes. She has one goal - get Marie’s journal. When she picks it up, the memories come back. Because twenty years ago Kelsey and Marie shared this room. They spent days in it working on projects, nights talking about boys, pizza and sparkly shoes. Dreaming about the future, planning their life. Until that ghastly night. When it was all shattered to pieces.
 
 What happened to Marie and Kelsey twenty years ago? 
 
 Search Marie's room and join Kelsey in her trip down memory lane. Open drawers, pick up objects. Learn what Kelsey remembers, read what Marie thought about it. As you puzzle the pieces together, you uncover the secrets of their friendship. 
 
  "She asked me why I was so angry all the time. And I told her -- because it’s a dirty deal. It’s Russian roulette and utterly unfair. The cards I’d been dealt, any player would have passed. I chose to be angry instead. But Marie, my friend Marie, she got me a new deck. And suggested that I deal again." - Kelsey  The team behind the game 
  Creative Direction - Art & Programming 
 Kenny Guillaume
 
  Writing - Dialogue - Story 
 Dagmar Blommaert
 
  Voice acting 
 Lauren Hendler
 Lauren Ann Higgins
 
  Music 
 Dries Vienne
 Simon Alexander
 
  Audio Mastering 
 Ward Snauwaert

title: NetDive
description:
This is a story about an AI prompted to learn what makes a human human.
  
  Take in stimulations, learn and reinforce to increase  capability, retrain with more initial conditions when needed.
        
  Dive deep, break through the firewalls blocking the way.
        
   Can you learn what makes a human human? 
        
  
   Features: 
    • A short (~2.5hr ish) incremental game
    • A SHMUP flavored gameplay intercepting packets on the internet
   • A story, very specific to be told in this way
   • Skill tree of upgrades to explore
   • Chill soundtrack accompanying your journey

title: The Final Print
description:
Take the role of an investigative journalist in Harlem, in the early 1940s.
  
Someone has been murdered, and the explanations that the police have come up with just don't add up. Furthermore, the person that the police are accusing of the murder is a good friend of yours, so you'll do anything you can to find out the truth.
 
• Take Pictures  
Use your camera to collect evidence; take pictures of anything that seems important to the case.
     
 • Organize Evidence  
See the evidence you collected in your journal, where you can organize and look at the pictures.
     
  • Gather Clues 
 Talk to people to try and find out what they know. But be careful, some might try to lie to you, and hide the truth. Get their testimonies and piece together the real story
     
  • Solve the Case  
Build your case in the article and publish it to expose the true killer.

title: Sea Salt & Paper
description:
During your turn, you assemble your hand, maybe place cards for their effect, and decide if you want to end the round. But do you think you are the one with the most points in hand?
You will have to choose: stop the round immediately or give the others an extra turn to try to extend the gap? Is it worth taking the risk? 
The game ends when you reach 30/35/40 points (4/3/2 players).

The excitement of ending the round to catch your opponents off guard

The pleasure of playing your effect cards and making combos

It's a set collection card game like Rummy. The origami created especially for the game is just the illustrations on the cards.

title: Date Everything!
description: Date Everything is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

localized_description.text: Date Everything is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

《Date Everything!》为约会模拟器带来激动人心的全新玩法。  持有艺术学位的你，在客服岗位不幸被 AI 所淘汰，但……一个神秘的陌生人送来了一份礼物——被称为“约会客”的眼镜，它能将你的房屋变得生机勃勃，应约尽约！ 
  每件可约会的对象都有自己的故事，当它们敞开心扉之际，就有可能变成你的恋人、朋友或敌人。另外，你的整个旅程将有全明星阵容的配音演员一路相伴！
  
     
  游戏特色：
  ·100 名可约会角色
  
     
  ·全程配音
  ·分支叙事 
  
     
  ·每个可约会角色至少有 3 个结局
  
     
  ·双关梗管够！

《Date Everything!》為約會模擬遊戲帶來令人興奮的新變化。  在被AI搶了工作後，你客戶服務的專業技能沒了用武之地。然而……一位神祕陌生人送來一份禮物：名為「 約會之旅」的神奇眼鏡。這副眼鏡讓房子「活」了起來，你多彩多姿的約會生活也就此掀起序幕！ 
  每位可約會的對象都有各自的故事，並有機會成為你的戀人、朋友，或敵人。 所有角色都有配音，陪你一同進行這場約會之旅！
  
     
  Features: - 
  • 100 名可約會角色
  
     
  • 全程語音配音
  • 分支劇情 
  
     
  • 每名可約會角色皆有至少3種結局
  
     
  • 豐富雙關語！

Date Everything! brings an exciting new twist on the dating simulator genre.   Your BFA in customer service unfortunately goes to waste as you lose your job to AI. But... a mysterious stranger sends a gift - magical glasses called 'Dateviators' - which make your house come alive and dateable!
    
  Each dateable object will open up, have their own stories and potentially become your lovers, friends, or enemies. With an exhaustive Who's Who of voice actors keeping you company on your journey!

Date Everything! supone un giro nuevo y emocionante en el género de los simuladores de citas.   Por desgracia, tu licenciatura en atención al cliente deja de ser útil cuando te despiden para darle tu trabajo a una IA. Sin embargo, un misterioso desconocido te envía un regalo: unas gafas mágicas llamadas «dateviators», ¡que harán que tu casa cobre vida y puedas tener citas con lo que hay en ella! 
  Todos los objetos con los que puedes salir tendrán sus propias historias, podrán sincerarse contigo y convertirse en tus amantes, amigos o enemigos. El juego cuenta con un gran elenco de actores de voz conocidos para acompañarte en tu viaje.
  
     
  Características: -
  • 100 personajes con los que salir.
  
     
  • Personajes completamente doblados.
  • Narrativas ramificadas.
  
     
  • Un mínimo de 3 finales para cada personaje.
  
     
  • ¡Con montones de juegos de palabras!

Date Everything! apporte un vent de fraîcheur excitant aux simulations de rencontres.   L’IA t’a piqué ton travail ? Dans ce cas, il ne te reste plus qu’à bazarder ton diplôme en relation client. Mais l’heure n’est pas à la déprime, car un mystérieux inconnu vient de t’envoyer un cadeau : des lunettes magiques appelées « Dateviators ». Enfile-les sans plus tarder et commence à flirter avec une maison plus qu’animée ! 
  Découvre les histoires personnelles des objets à séduire. Deviendront-ils tes amants, tes amis ou tes ennemis ? Et bien entendu, un casting exhaustif de doubleurs talentueux sera là pour te tenir compagnie !
  
     
  Caractéristiques :
  • 100 personnages à séduire
  
     
  • Un jeu entièrement doublé
  • Une narration à choix multiples
  
  
     
  • Au moins 3 fins différentes par personnage à séduire
  
     
  • Des jeux de mots à profusion !

Mit Date Everything! nimmt das Dating-Simulator-Genre eine aufregende neue Wendung.   Du hast deinen Job an eine KI verloren und nun ist dein BA in Dienstleistungsmanagement das Papier für die Urkunde kaum noch wert. Doch dann schenkt dir ein mysteriöser Fremder eine magische Brille namens „Dateviators“, die dein Zuhause zum Leben erweckt … und zum Anbeißen attraktiv macht! 
  Jedes Objekt, das du daten kannst, hat eine Geschichte zu erzählen und könnte sich zu einer Liebschaft, einem Freund oder einem Feind entwickeln. Ausgestattet mit einem ganzen Katalog an bekannten Synchronsprechern wird dir auf dieser Reise niemals langweilig!
  
     
  Features:
  • 100 datebare Charaktere
  
     
  • Komplett in englischer Sprache synchronisiert
  • Verzweigte Geschichten
  
     
  • Mindestens 3 mögliche Enden pro datebarem Charakter
  
     
  • Witze ohne Ende!

Date Everything! dá um novo toque de emoção ao género de simulador de encontros.   

A tua licenciatura em apoio ao cliente infelizmente é desperdiçada quando perdes o teu emprego para a IA. Mas... um desconhecido misterioso enviou um presente - uns óculos mágicos chamados “aviamores” - que fazem com que a tua casa ganhe vida e seja namorável! 

Cada objeto namorável irá abrir-se, ter as suas próprias histórias e potencialmente tornar-se no teu amante, amigo ou inimigo. 

Com um grande elenco de dobradores para te fazer companhia na tua viagem! 
 
Características:

  • 100 personagens “namoráveis”
  • Totalmente dobrado
  • Narrativas ramificadas
  • Pelo menos 3 finais por personagem namorável
  • Trocadilhos aos montes!

恋愛シミュレーションゲームに新たな旋風を巻き起こすエキサイティングなゲーム「Date Everything!」の登場です！  苦労して手に入れたカスタマーサービスの博士号。その喜びも一瞬の出来事、仕事をAIに奪われて涙目ぽろぽろプライドズタズタ。そこに見知らぬ人物から悲しみを癒やす贈り物が。その名も「デートアクティベーター」という魔法のメガネ。掛ければなんと！家じゅうのモノが擬人化されて、その上仲良くなれちゃうという代物！ 
  家じゅうのモノとどんどん話して打ち解け合ったら、その先は友だちに？恋人に？それとも、恋のライバルに？しかもこのゲームはフルボイス対応！豪華声優陣がゲームプレイに華を添えてくれちゃいます！ 
  
     
  推しポイント：
  ・ 登場キャラクターはなんと100人！（100個？）
  
     
  ・ 心を揺さぶるフルボイス対応！
  ・ 分岐するドキドキストーリー！
  
     
  ・ キャラクターごとに３つ以上のエンディング！
  
     
  ・ コミカル！ジョーク！大騒ぎ！

Date Everything! brings an exciting new twist on the dating simulator genre.   Your BFA in customer service unfortunately goes to waste as you lose your job to AI. But... a mysterious stranger sends a gift - magical glasses called 'Dateviators' - which make your house come alive and dateable!
    
  Each dateable object will open up, have their own stories and potentially become your lovers, friends, or enemies. With an exhaustive Who's Who of voice actors keeping you company on your journey!

Date Everything! giver et spændende nyt twist på datingsimulator-genren.   Din universitetsgrad i kundeservice går desværre til spilde, da du mister dit job til AI. Men ... en mystisk fremmed sender en gave - magiske briller kaldet 'dateviators' - som gør dit hus levende og datebart!  
  Hver datebare genstand åbner sig, har sine egne historier og kan blive din elsker, ven eller fjende. Med et omfattende persongalleri af stemmeskuespillere, der holder dig med selskab på din rejse! 
  
     
  Funktioner: - 
  • 100 karakterer, der kan dates
  
     
  • Fuldt ud stemmestyret
  • Forgrenede fortællinger 
  
     
  • Mindst 3 slutninger pr. datebare karakter
  
     
  • Ordspil i massevis!

Date Everything! introduce un'inedita ed emozionante svolta nel genere "simulazione di appuntamenti".   La tua laurea in Servizio clienti purtroppo si rivela inutile: l'intelligenza artificiale ti ruba il lavoro. Tuttavia... un misterioso sconosciuto ti invia un regalo: degli occhiali magici chiamati "deviatori", che danno vita agli oggetti della tua casa rendendoli "frequentabili"! 
  Ogni oggetto con cui puoi uscire si aprirà, avrà una sua storia e potrebbe diventare il tuo nuovo amore, amico o nemico. E a ciascuno di essi presta la voce un attore o un'attrice dedicati, per tenerti compagnia nel tuo viaggio!
  
     
  Caratteristiche:
  • 100 personaggi frequentabili
  
     
  • Completamente doppiato
  • Bivi narrativi
  
     
  • Almeno 3 finali per personaggio frequentabile
  
     
  • Una valanga di giochi di parole!

brief: Date Everything is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

title: Undertale
description:
Welcome to UNDERTALE. In this RPG, you control a human who falls underground into the world of monsters. Now you must find your way out... or stay trapped forever. 
 
  ((Healthy Dog's Warning: Game contains imagery that may be harmful to players with photosensitive epilepsy or similar condition.))  

features: 
• Killing is unnecessary: negotiate out of danger using the unique battle system.
    • Time your attacks for extra damage, then dodge enemy attacks in a style reminiscent of top-down shooters.
    • Original art and soundtrack brimming with personality.
    • Soulful, character-rich story with an emphasis on humor.
    • Created mostly by one person. 
    • Become friends with all of the bosses!
    • At least 5 dogs.
    • You can date a skeleton.
    • Hmmm... now there are 6 dogs...?
    • Maybe you won't want to date the skeleton.
    • I thought I found a 7th dog, but it was actually just the 3rd dog.
    • If you play this game, can you count the dogs for me...? I'm not good at it.

A small child falls into the Underground, where monsters have long been banished by humans and are hunting every human that they find. The player controls the child as they try to make it back to the Surface through hostile environments, all the while engaging with a turn-based combat system with puzzle-solving and bullet hell elements, as well as other unconventional game mechanics.

"A long time ago, two races ruled peacefully over the Earth: HUMANS and MONSTERS. One day, a terrible war broke out between the two races. After a long battle, the humans were victorious. They sealed the monsters underground with a magical spell.

In the year 201X, a small child scales Mt. Ebott. It is said that those who climb the mountain never return.

Seeking refuge from the rainy weather, the child enters a cave and discovers an enormous hole.

Moving closer to get a better look... the child falls in.

Now, our story begins."

title: Night in the Woods
description:
College dropout Mae Borowski returns home to the crumbling former mining town of Possum Springs seeking to resume her aimless former life and reconnect with the friends she left behind. But things aren't the same. Home seems different now and her friends have grown and changed. Leaves are falling and the wind is growing colder. Strange things are happening as the light fades.
 

 
And there's something in the woods.
 

 
NIGHT IN THE WOODS is an adventure game focused on exploration, story, and character, featuring dozens of characters to meet and lots to do across a lush, vibrant world. After a successful Kickstarter it's being made by Infinite Fall, a teamup of Alec Holowka (Aquaria), Scott Benson (Late Night Work Club), and Bethany Hockenberry.

Night In The Woods is an adventure game heavily focused on story, characters and exploration, with some platforming to get around town. Mae's a cat so the roofs and ledges and powerlines are all her playground, and she's not the only one up there by a long shot. You'll also be doing various activities and interacting with the world in different ways, getting to know the townspeople, hanging out with friends, exploring Possum Springs inside and out, and venturing into the surrounding areas.

Night In The Woods is a VIDEO GAME. All Mae wants to do is run around with her friends, break stuff and hang on to a life of aggressive aimlessness. She dropped out of college and returned home to her crumbling old mining town to do just that, but she's finding that nothing is the same anymore. The old town seems different. Her old friends have grown in their own directions. Mae herself is undergoing some sudden and unexplained changes, giving her mysterious abilities that grant her access to a side of town she never knew existed.
The world is changing, things are ending, and the future is uncertain. Up behind the park at the edge of town, back in the trees by the old mine- there's something in the woods. And it could mean no future at all.
Night In The Woods comes from a deep place for us. That point where you sense things are changing and it's time to move on but you just don't know how. Knowing that everything will end someday, and wondering how well we'll be able to meet it when it happens. How long we'll be able to hold on, and when we should let go. When to accept and when to fight.

生きづらさを抱えるあなたに捧ぐ、小さな田舎町の愛と友情の物語 とある田舎町のポッサム・スプリング。
 大学を中退し帰ってきた主人公のメイは、日々、地元の友人とバンド練習をしたり、いたずらしたり、パーティーに参加したりと楽しくも刹那的に過ごしています。
 でも、彼女を含め、取り巻く人達・環境は昔と変わらず、というわけにはいきません。
 メイも友人もさまざまな問題を抱えて生きています。メイは人々との交流を通じて、それぞれの問題と向き合います。
 その中で、ポッサム・スプリングで発生している失踪事件に巻き込まれ、さらなる大きな問題と対峙することになります。 ゲーム内容 本作は、キャラクターとの会話主体で進行する2Dアドベンチャーゲームです。
 町中を走り回りさまざまなキャラクターと会話しましょう。
 会話内容は多岐に渡ります。正解のない選択に迷うかもしれません。深刻な悩みの告白に驚くかもしれません。
 どのような選択でも人生と同じでゲームオーバーはありません。選択後のリアルな展開をお楽しみください。
 ストーリーの合間にはさまざまなミニゲームが用意されています。
 バンド練習でベーシストになったり車を壊したりと、メイたちの行動と密接にシンクロしており、ミニゲームを通じてより一層プレイヤーはこの不思議な世界へと没入していくことができます。

title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
description: Race across land, sea, air, space, and time in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.

localized_description.text: Race across land, sea, air, space, and time in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.

Race across land, sea, air, and space in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn. Speed to victory solo or as a team in a variety of offline and online modes and compete against players from around the world. Build the ultimate vehicle to match your racing style, unlock gadgets to gain the upper hand, and unleash power-up items!
        
   Come Race on Our Level   Race across 24* courses and warp to one of 15 CrossWorld courses with Travel Rings, which transport you to a new course with special rules and challenges on the 2nd lap. Return to the first course for the final lap, where aspects of the track have changed. There’s always a surprise on the other side of the Travel Rings, and no two races are the same!
        
   Minutes to Learn, a Lifetime to Master   

Pick from over 45 unique original vehicles and over 70** gadgets that let you shape how you race and define your playstyle. Gadgets let you customize all parts of your race, including movement boost efficiency, item chance, recovery time, and more. Build the loadout that defines you.
  
There are 5 character/vehicle classes to choose from: Speed, Acceleration, Handling, Power, and Boost. Within each class, you can further tune performance by combining front, rear, and tire parts, adjusting each stat to match your racing style. Top it all off with custom paint jobs, decals, and more to create your ultimate racing machine.
        
   The Largest Roster Ever!   

Choose from 23 iconic Sonic characters! From members of Team Sonic to the Babylon Rogues, Team Chaotix, and even the Deadly Six, it’s the largest roster in a Sonic racing game to date.

  Characters have unique interactions with each other through the new Rival system, which randomly picks a character each race to be your Rival who will be faster, smarter, and more challenging. Defeat them for bonus rewards and even more special dialogue.
        
   Play Your Way  

 Hone your skills solo, co-op with friends, or online with up to 12 players in modes designed for competition, practice, and mastery.

  • Compete in the classic Grand Prix: compete across 4 courses to earn the most points.
  • Mix it up with Race Park: Race in teams of 2-4 players in matches with unique rule sets: collect the most rings, boost off your allies, knock out your opponent, play with only heavy hitting items, or make up your own custom rulesets!
  • Master individual courses with Time Trials: Race alone on a single course as you try to get the fastest time possible. Your time can be uploaded to a global leaderboard to show off your mastery.
  • Ascend the online leaderboards in World Match: Play online with players worldwide in 12 player lobbies and aim for the top: Legend Rank.
        
   A Racing Experience That Continues to Evolve  

 Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds will be supported by ongoing free updates that add new characters, vehicles, music, sounds, and gadgets. Characters from across the SEGA universe including Joker, Ichiban, Hatsune Miku, AiAi, and NiGHTS join the race, with more characters to arrive soon.

  For those looking to expand their experience, unlock premium content through the Season Pass, which features guest crossovers from iconic franchises including SpongeBob SquarePants and Minecraft. Character Packs from the Season Pass will feature 2-4 playable racers***, new courses, decals and sounds to customize your vehicle, additional music, gadgets, and more.

   Race for Fun, Race for Glory   

The free character updates and paid premium content will be supported by Festivals, limited time events where you’ll team up players worldwide to represent one of 3 teams and compete for the most points. Races will feature unique rulesets during these events, with the winning team earning bonus rewards.

  For the best-of-the-best, test your skills in Legend Competitions. These timed events feature a unique competitive ruleset and open only to other top players (Legend 9 rank and above in World Match). Aim for the top to receive special rewards and shoot for the coveted “Emerald Racer” rank.

  *More courses may be added post-launch
  **Additional gadgets may be added post-launch
  ***Please see Season Pass & individual Content Packs for more information on playable characters

¡Corre por tierra, mar, aire y espacio en Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Teletranspórtate a través de los Rings de travesía a nuevas dimensiones, donde te aguardan sorpresas en cada giro y curva. Acelera hacia la victoria en solitario o en equipo en una gran variedad de modos locales y en línea, y compite contra jugadores de todo el mundo. ¡Crea un vehículo que se adapte a ti, desbloquea artilugios para ganar ventaja y usa potenciadores!
        
   Ven a competir a nuestro nivel   Compite por 24* circuitos y teletranspórtate a uno de los 15 CrossWorlds con los Rings de travesía, que te llevan a un nuevo circuito con reglas y desafíos especiales en la segunda vuelta. Regresa al primer circuito para la última vuelta, donde te esperan sorpresas y cambios en el trazado de la pista. Los Rings de travesía siempre esconden una sorpresa al otro lado. ¡No hay dos carreras iguales!
        
   Fácil de aprender, difícil de dominar  

 Elige entre más de 45 vehículos únicos y más de 70** artilugios que definen tu estilo de juego. Personaliza con artilugios todos los aspectos de la carrera, como la eficacia del turbo, la probabilidad de obtener objetos y el tiempo de recuperación. Crea tu configuración.

  Hay 5 clases de personajes/vehículos: velocidad, aceleración, conducción, potencia y turbo. Ajusta su rendimiento con piezas delanteras, traseras y neumáticos, y modifica cada parámetro adaptándolo a tu estilo. Da el toque final con carrocerías personalizadas, pegatinas y más para montar tu vehículo definitivo.
        
   Un elenco enorme  

 ¡Elige entre 23 personajes emblemáticos de Sonic! Desde el Equipo Sonic hasta los Babylon Rogues, el Equipo Chaotix e incluso los Mortíferos Seis, es el plantel más completo en un juego de carreras de Sonic hasta ahora.

  Los personajes tienen interacciones únicas con el nuevo sistema de rivales, que selecciona al azar un rival en cada carrera y lo hace más rápido, astuto y desafiante. Derrótalo y gana recompensas y diálogos exclusivos.
        
   Juega a tu manera 

  Afina tu técnica en solitario, coopera con amigos o juega en línea con hasta 12 jugadores en modos diseñados para competir, practicar y dominar.

  • Gran Premio clásico: compite en 4 circuitos por la mayor puntuación.
  • Parque de competición: compite en equipos de 2 a 4 jugadores con reglas únicas. Recoge la mayor cantidad de Rings, ayuda a tus aliados con turbos, elimina a tus oponentes, juega solo con objetos de gran impacto o crea reglas personalizadas.
  • Pruebas contrarreloj: compite en solitario en un circuito y logra el mejor tiempo posible. Comparte tu tiempo en la clasificación mundial y exhibe tu dominio.
  • Partidas globales y clasificación en línea: juega contra jugadores internacionales en salas de 12 participantes y lucha por alcanzar el rango legendario.
        
   Una experiencia de carreras en evolución   

Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds contará con actualizaciones periódicas gratis que añadirán personajes, vehículos, música, sonidos y artilugios. Personajes del universo SEGA, como Joker, Ichiban, Hatsune Miku, AiAi y NiGHTS, se suman a la competición, con más personajes en camino.

  Amplía tu experiencia con el contenido de pago del pase de temporada, que incluye colaboraciones con franquicias como Bob Esponja y Minecraft. Los packs de personajes del pase de temporada incluyen entre 2 y 4 corredores jugables***, circuitos, pegatinas y sonidos para personalizar tu vehículo, música, artilugios y más.

   Corre por diversión y por la fama  

 Las actualizaciones gratis de personajes y el contenido de pago vienen acompañados de festivales, eventos de tiempo limitado donde representas a uno de los 3 equipos y compites con jugadores de todo el mundo por la mayor puntuación. Las carreras tendrán reglas especiales durante estos eventos, y el equipo ganador obtendrá recompensas.

  Si te consideras de los mejores, ponte a prueba en las competiciones legendarias. Son eventos cronometrados con reglas únicas, abiertos solo a jugadores de élite (rango legendario 9 o más en partidas globales). Apunta a lo más alto para recibir recompensas especiales y lucha por el codiciado rango «Corredor de esmeralda».

  * Pueden añadirse más circuitos tras el lanzamiento.
  * Pueden añadirse más artilugios tras el lanzamiento.
  *** Consulta el pase de temporada y los packs de contenido individuales para más información sobre personajes jugables.

Fais la course sur terre, dans l'eau, dans les airs et à travers l'espace dans Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds ! Téléporte-toi dans de nouvelles dimensions grâce aux Rings de transfert où des surprises t'attendent à chaque tournant. Fonce jusqu'à la victoire en solo ou en équipe dans divers modes en ligne ou hors ligne et affronte des joueuses et joueurs des quatre coins du monde. Crée le véhicule ultime, déverrouille des gadgets pour dominer la course et active des améliorations!
        
   Viens faire la course sur notre circuit   

Parcours 24* circuits et téléporte-toi sur l’un des 15 circuits du CrossWorld avec les Rings de transfert, qui t'emmènent sur un nouveau circuit au 2e tour. Retourne sur le premier circuit pour le dernier tour, où certains éléments de la piste auront changé. Il y a toujours une surprise avec les Rings de transfert, et aucune course n’est la même !

   Quelques minutes pour apprendre, une vie pour maîtriser. 

  Sélectionne parmi plus de 45 véhicules et 70** gadgets pour modifier ton style de course. Les gadgets te permettent de personnaliser ta course, y compris les turbos, la probabilité d'objets, le temps de récupération et plus. Choisis l'équipement qui te convient.

  Il y a 5 classes de véhicules : Vitesse, Accélération, Conduite, Puissance et Turbo. Tu peux affiner tes performances en adaptant les pièces mécaniques avant, arrière et les pneus et chaque statistique à ton style. Complète le tout avec des peintures personnalisées, des autocollants et plus pour créer ta machine ultime.
        
   Le plus grand nombre de pilotes à ce jour !   

Choisis l'un des 23 personnages emblématiques de l'univers de Sonic ! L’équipe Sonic, les Babylon Rogues, l’équipe Chaotix et même les Effroyables Six, c’est le plus grand nombre de pilotes dans un jeu Sonic Racing.

  Les personnages disposent d'interactions uniques grâce au système de rivalité, qui choisit un personnage qui deviendra un rival plus rapide, intelligent et redoutable. Bats-les pour décrocher des récompenses bonus et débloquer des dialogues spéciaux !
        
   Joue à ta manière   

Peaufine tes compétences en solo, en coop, ou en ligne dans des modes compétition, entraînement et maîtrise pouvant accueillir jusqu’à 12 pilotes.

  • Participe au Grand Prix classique : rivalise sur 4 circuits pour obtenir le plus de points.
  • Découvre le mode Aire de compétition ! Fais la course en équipes de 2 à 4 dans des matchs uniques : récupère le plus de Rings, renforce tes alliés, élimine tes adversaires, joue uniquement avec des objets puissants, ou crée tes propres règles !
  • Maîtrise chaque circuit en Contre la montre : essaie d'obtenir le meilleur temps en solo. Publie ton temps au classement mondial !
  • Gravis les classements avec Match mondial : joue avec des joueurs et joueuses du monde entier dans des salons de 12 joueurs et vise le rang Légendaire.
        
   Une expérience en constante évolution   

Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds comptera sur des mises à jour gratuites, ajoutant de nouveaux personnages, véhicules, musiques, sons et gadgets. Des personnages de l’univers SEGA, dont Joker, Ichiban, Hatsune Miku, AiAi et NiGHTS, rejoignent la course, avec plus de personnages à venir.

  Et si tu souhaites enrichir ton expérience, débloque du contenu premium grâce au Season Pass, avec des invités de franchises comme Bob l'éponge et Minecraft. Les packs de personnages du Season Pass proposeront 2 à 4 pilotes jouables***, de nouveaux circuits, des autocollants et sons, de la musique, des gadgets, et plus.
        
   Cours pour le plaisir, cours pour la gloire  

 Les mises à jour gratuites de personnages et le contenu premium payant seront accompagnés de festivals, des événements avec d'autres pilotes pour représenter l’une des 3 équipes et viser le plus de points. Les courses proposeront des règles uniques et l’équipe gagnante remportera des bonus.

  Pour les pilotes d'élite, teste tes compétences en Compétitions des légendes. Ces événements proposent des règles uniques pour les pilotes d'élite (rang Légendaire 9 et plus en Match mondial). Vise le sommet pour des récompenses spéciales et tente d’atteindre le rang Pilote Émeraude.

  *D’autres circuits pourraient être ajoutés après lancement
  **D’autres gadgets pourraient être ajoutés après lancement
  ***Consulte le Season Pass et les packs de contenu individuels pour plus d’infos sur les personnages jouables

Rase in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds durch Land, Meer, Luft und Raum! Warpe durch Reiseringe in neue Dimensionen, in denen hinter jeder Kurve etwas Neues wartet. Brause allein oder im Team in einer Vielzahl von Modi zum Sieg und tritt gegen Spieler aus aller Welt an. Baue das Fahrzeug für deinen Rennstil, schalte Gadgets frei und entfessle Power-Ups, um zu gewinnen!
        
   Fahre Rennen auf unserem Level   

Rase über 24* Strecken und warpe mit Reiseringen zu 15 CrossWorld-Strecken, die dich mit besonderen Regeln und Herausforderungen konfrontieren. Kehre danach zur ersten Strecke zurück, die sich nun verändert hat. Reiseringe bieten stets eine Überraschung, und keine zwei Rennen sind gleich!
        
   Schnell gelernt und doch schwer zu meistern   

Wähle aus über 45 Fahrzeugen und über 70** Gadgets, mit denen du deinen Spielstil gestalten kannst. Mit Gadgets kannst du alle Aspekte deines Rennens anpassen, darunter die Effizienz von Turbos, die Wahrscheinlichkeit, Gegenstände zu erhalten, die Erholungszeit und mehr. Stelle deinen Loadout zusammen.

  Es stehen 5 Charakter-/Fahrzeugklassen zur Auswahl: Tempo, Beschleunigung, Handling, Stärke und Turbo. Du kannst jede weiter optimieren, indem du Teile sowie Reifen kombinierst und an deinen Stil anpasst. Verpasse deiner ultimativen Rennmaschine mit Lackierungen, Aufklebern und mehr den letzten Schliff.
        
   Der größte Kader aller Zeiten!   Wähle aus 23 Sonic-Charakteren! Von Team Sonic über die Babylon Rogues und Team Chaotix bis hin zu den Schrecklichen Sechs ist dies die bislang größte Auswahl an Charakteren in einem „Sonic Racing“-Spiel.

  Sie interagieren durch das neue Rivalensystem auf einzigartige Weise miteinander. Es wählt zufällig einen Gegner als deinen Rivalen aus, der schneller, schlauer und herausfordernder ist. Besiege ihn, um Belohnungen zu erhalten und besondere Dialoge zu hören.
        
   Spiele, wie du willst   

Verbessere deine Fähigkeiten alleine, im Koop-Modus mit Freunden oder online mit bis zu 12 Spielern.

  • Nimm am Grand Prix teil: Fahre auf 4 Strecken und erziele die meisten Punkte, um zu gewinnen.
  • Tritt im Rennpark in Teams von 2 bis 4 Spielern mit besonderen Regeln an. Sammle die meisten Ringe, nutze den Turbo deiner Verbündeten, schalte Gegner aus, nutze nur die mächtigsten Gegenstände oder spiele nach eigenen Regeln!
  • Meistere Strecken im Zeitrennen: Versuche, die schnellste Zeit zu erzielen. Deine Zeit kann daraufhin in eine globale Bestenliste eingetragen werden.
  • Steige in den Online-Bestenlisten von World-Match auf: Spiele in Lobbys für bis zu 12 Teilnehmer und erringe den Legenden-Rang.
        
   Ein Rennerlebnis, das sich weiterentwickelt 

  Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds wird durch kostenlose Updates unterstützt, die neue Charaktere, Fahrzeuge, Musik, Sounds und Gadgets hinzufügen. Charaktere aus dem SEGA-Universum, darunter Joker, Ichiban, Hatsune Miku, AiAi und NiGHTS, nehmen am Rennen teil, und weitere werden bald folgen.

  Für alle, die ihr Erlebnis erweitern möchten, gibt es Premium-Inhalte über den Saisonpass, der Gast-CrossOver aus Franchises wie SpongeBob Schwammkopf und Minecraft umfasst. Die Charakterpacks aus dem Saisonpass enthalten 2 bis 4 Rennfahrer***, neue Strecken, Aufkleber und Sounds zur Individualisierung deines Fahrzeugs, zusätzliche Musik, Gadgets und vieles mehr.

   Fahre zum Spaß, fahre für Ruhm  

 Die kostenlosen Charakter-Updates und kostenpflichtigen Premium-Inhalte werden durch Festivals ergänzt – zeitlich begrenzte Events, bei denen du mit Spielern aus aller Welt Teams bildest und um die meisten Punkte kämpfst. Die Rennen werden während dieser Events nach besonderen Regeln ausgetragen, wobei das Gewinnerteam Belohnungen erhält.

  Auf die Besten der Besten wartet noch der Legendenwettkampf. Diese zeitlich begrenzten Events haben einzigartige Regeln und stehen nur Top-Spielern zur Verfügung (ab Legenden-Rang 9 im World-Match). Strebe nach der Spitze, um Belohnungen zu erhalten, und kämpfe um den begehrten Smaragd-Rennfahrer-Rang.

  * Nach Veröffentlichung können weitere Strecken hinzugefügt werden.
  ** Nach Veröffentlichung können weitere Gadgets hinzugefügt werden.
  *** Weitere Informationen zu spielbaren Charakteren findest du im Saisonpass und in den einzelnen Inhaltspacks.

Acelera por terra, ar, mar e espaço no Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Usa os Travel Rings para viajar entre dimensões com surpresas a cada curva.

  Acelera até à vitória numa grande variedade de modos offline e online, e compete contra jogadores de todo o mundo. Cria o veículo perfeito à medida do teu estilo de condução, desbloqueia engenhocas vantajosas e usa os teus poderosos itens para conquistares a vitória!

   Preparados, a postos, teletransporte! 

  Acelera por 24 pistas e teletransporta-te até 15 CrossWorlds com Travel Rings, uma mecânica de jogo única que transporta as icónicas personagens dos universos Sonic e SEGA a novas dimensões. Usa a imprevisibilidade a teu favor e muda o cenário de cada corrida!

   Corre com os melhores! 

  Escolhe de entre 23 personagens icónicas do Sonic, o maior elenco de um jogo de corridas Sonic!

   Personaliza 

  Combina 45 veículos originais únicos e 70 engenhocas diferentes para melhorar a tua corrida, subir o nível do teu kart e criar a derradeira máquina para o teu estilo de corrida.

   Ganha vantagem com itens poderosos! 

  Domina os adversários com 23 itens, incluindo alguns populares que estão de regresso e novos itens como o Monster Truck!

   Várias maneiras de jogar 

  Junta-te a amigos e joga em ecrã dividido local no Grand Prix e no novo modo de grupo Race Park, compete contra jogadores de todo o mundo e sobe na classificação do World Match, joga contra amigos online em lobbies de 12 jogadores com regras personalizadas no Friend Match ou testa as tuas habilidades de condução em Time Trials.

Sfreccia sul tracciato, sull'acqua, in aria e nello spazio con Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Sfrutta i Ring di trasferimento per teletrasportarti in nuove dimensioni in cui ogni angolo nasconde una sorpresa. Corri verso la vittoria in solitaria o in squadra, in modalità offline o online e affronta giocatori da tutto il mondo. Costruisci l'auto perfetta per il tuo stile di guida, sblocca gadget, batti gli avversari e scatena i tuoi poteri!
        
   Vieni a gareggiare!   

Affronta 24* percorsi e teletrasportati su uno dei 15 percorsi CrossWorld con i Ring di trasferimento: nel 2° giro sarai su un nuovo tracciato con regole e sfide speciali. All'ultimo giro tornerai al percorso originario... che avrà cambiato aspetto! I Ring di trasferimento riservano sempre sorprese: tutte le gare sono diverse!

           Entrare nel divertimento illimitato è facile   

Scegli tra 45 veicoli unici e originali e oltre 70** gadget con cui dare forma alla tua gara e al tuo stile di gioco. Con i gadget, personalizza ogni aspetto: l'efficienza del turbo, la probabilità di trovare oggetti, il tempo di recupero e altro. Crea la dotazione che ti rappresenta.

  Le classi di personaggi/veicoli sono 5: velocità, accelerazione, maneggevolezza, potenza e turbo. Affina la resa di ogni classe combinando pezzi anteriori, posteriori e pneumatici con cui adattare le statistiche al tuo stile. Dai il tocco finale con vernici personalizzate, adesivi e altro per creare l'auto perfetta.
        
   La più ampia scuderia di sempre!   

Scegli fra 23 personaggi iconici di Sonic! Dai membri del Team Sonic ai Babylon Rogues, Chaotix e perfino i Sei Nefasti, questa scuderia è la più ampia dei giochi di corse di Sonic.

  I personaggi hanno interazioni uniche con il nuovo sistema dei rivali, che seleziona per te un personaggio rivale casuale, che sarà più veloce, intelligente e impegnativo. Battilo e ricevi premi bonus e altri dialoghi speciali.
        
   Gioca come vuoi   

Affina le abilità in solitaria, con gli amici oppure online con un massimo di 12 giocatori in modalità pensate per sfidarsi, esercitarsi e migliorare.

  • Affronta il Gran Premio classico: gareggia su 4 percorsi mirando al punteggio più alto.
  • Aggiungi varietà con il Parco delle Corse: in squadre da 2-4 giocatori, affronta partite con regole uniche. Raccogli più Ring, fai mangiare la polvere agli avversari, gioca pesante o inventa le tue regole!
  • Domina i percorsi con Corsa contro il Tempo: gareggia in solitaria su un percorso puntando al miglior tempo possibile. Carica il tuo risultato sulla classifica globale: tutti vedranno quanto vali.
  • Scala le classifiche online con World Match: affronta online giocatori di tutto il mondo in 12 lobby e punta al Grado Leggenda.
        
   Un'esperienza di gara in continua evoluzione 

  Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds verrà aggiornato continuamente con nuovi personaggi, veicoli, brani musicali, effetti sonori e gadget. Si uniranno alla corsa vari personaggi dell'universo SEGA, tra cui Joker, Ichiban, Hatsune Miku, AiAi, NiGHTS e altri che arriveranno presto.

  Chi desidera espandere l'esperienza può sbloccare contenuti premium con il pass stagionale, che introduce ospiti da serie iconiche come SpongeBob SquarePants e Minecraft. I pacchetti personaggi del pass stagionale includeranno 2-4 piloti giocabili***, nuovi percorsi, adesivi e suoni con cui personalizzare il veicolo, musiche, gadget e altro.

   Gareggiare per divertirsi... e per la gloria   

Gli aggiornamenti gratuiti ai personaggi e i contenuti premium a pagamento saranno affiancati da Festival, eventi a tempo in cui fare squadra con giocatori di tutto il mondo per rappresentare una di tre squadre e mirare a ottenere più punti. Le gare avranno regole uniche e la squadra vincitrice otterrà premi bonus.

  E per puntare alla vetta assoluta, mettiti alla prova nella Gara leggendaria. Questo evento a tempo ha regole competitive uniche ed è aperto solo ai migliori giocatori (grado Leggenda 9 o superiore nel World Match). Mira al massimo per ricevere premi speciali e ottenere il titolo di "Pilota Smeraldo".

  *Dopo il lancio potrebbero essere aggiunti altri percorsi
  **Dopo il lancio potrebbero essere aggiunti altri gadget
  ***Per ulteriori dettagli sui personaggi giocabili, consulta il pass stagionale e i singoli pacchetti contenuto

brief: Race across land, sea, air, space, and time in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.

title: Enshrouded
description:
The realm of Embervale is lost. In their greed for magical power, your ancestors unleashed a pestilence that consumed the world.
  
  Enshrouded is a game of survival, crafting, and Action RPG combat, set within a sprawling voxel-based continent. As you journey across the mountains and deserts of an open world, you are free to choose your path and shape your destiny.
  
  Ignite the Ancient power of the Flame, and piece together the fragments of a story that unfolds below the surface.
  
   SURVIVE THE SHROUD  
 You start with nothing but the will to survive the wilds. You must scrape and scavenge through the ruined remnants of a lost kingdom, and fend off the beasts that hunger for your flesh.
  
  Journey through forests, caves, dungeons, searching for secret knowledge and treasure. Build the strength to venture into the Shroud and bring the fight back to the horrors of the deep.
  
       
   HEART POUNDING ACTION COMBAT   
The Shroud consumes the land it corrupts, mutating and guiding all life it encounters. Cleave your way through ravaging factions and formidable bosses, battling Scavenger in the forests, Vukah in the caves, and Fell creatures in the mist.
  
  Duck, parry, and surprise your foes with unexpected fighting skills and powerful spells. Exploit the weaknesses of your enemies as you develop your own unique playstyle with an in-depth skill tree system.
  
       
   CREATE EPIC BUILDS  
 Bring life back to the land! Voxel-based building unleashes your creative vision, allowing you to create grand architecture on an epic scale, customized with a vast assortment of materials and furniture. Build not only for yourself, because NPCs will take refuge within your walls, unlocking advanced workshops and the ability to craft epic weapons and armor.
  
       
   CRAFT GEAR WORTHY OF LEGEND   
Craft and customize a staggering array of legendary weapons and armor to become a force to be reckoned with. You'll need to master the shield, the sword, the staff and the bow to withstand the merciless advance of the Shroud.
  
       
   CALL UPON YOUR ALLIES   Join with friends in 16 player co-op gameplay. Carve out unique roles and complimentary skills that will prove your worth in battle as together you raid, gather treasure, and overcome the Fell hordes that ravage the land.
  
       
   UNLOCK THE SECRETS OF A FALLEN REALM   
Journey through the biomes of Embervale to immerse yourself in vibrant fallen cultures and ancient myths, from the mystical desert of the Kindlewastes to the dark canopies of The Revelwood.
  
  Within the fog, and beneath the ruins of a lost kingdom lies an ever-unfolding story of magic, ruin, hope, and redemption waiting to be discovered.

localized_description.text:
SOPRAVVIVERE NEL MANTO  
 Esplora le rovine, lotta contro la natura selvaggia e ottieni la forza necessaria per affrontare gli orrori che si celano nel Manto.
        
  IL MIGLIOR SISTEMA DI COSTRUZIONE IN CIRCOLAZIONE   
 Ridai vita alle terre del gioco con potenti strumenti di creazione voxel. Crea strutture grandiose, personalizza ogni dettaglio e offri rifugio ai PNG che sbloccano officine e mezzi per creare equipaggiamenti epici.
        
  COMBATTIMENTI ADRENALINICI   
 Affronta fazioni corrotte e boss letali contaminati dal Manto. Schiva, para e scatena potenti abilità e incantesimi, creando il tuo stile di combattimento personale come Stregone, Ranger o Guerriero.
        
  CREA UN EQUIPAGGIAMENTO LEGGENDARIO    
 Crea e potenzia armi e armature leggendarie. Espandi le tue abilità per padroneggiare spada, scudo, bastone e arco nella tua lotta contro il Manto.
        
  MULTIGIOCATORE, CO-OP 
 Unisciti a un massimo di 16 giocatori in modalità cooperativa per i raid, per costruire e per affrontare le orde dei Caduti con i tuoi amici.
       
  I SEGRETI DI UN REGNO CADUTO   
 Il regno di Val di brace è caduto. Nel perseguire un potere proibito, i tuoi antenati hanno scatenato un morbo che ha consumato il mondo.
 
Viaggia attraverso i suoi diversi biomi, dal Deserto bruciato arso dal sole alle profondità ombrose del Boscofestante, per scoprire i resti di culture perdute e miti dimenticati.
 
Sotto le rovine e nelle profondità del Manto si nasconde una storia di magia, rovina e redenzione. Ridesta l'antica Fiamma e riconquista la speranza che un tempo illuminava questo mondo perduto.

路线图    请查看我们的开发路线图，以及我们在抢先体验期间实装的内容 
        
 
 
  了解最新资讯，请关注我们：   
 
 
  关于游戏  薪谷王国已经陷入沉沦。出于对魔法力量的贪念，你的祖先们释放了一种吞噬世界的疫病。
  《Enshrouded》融合了生存、制作以及动作RPG战斗，游戏背景设定在了一个基于体素构筑的辽阔大陆。无论是攀登山脉还是跨越沙漠，你将可以在这个开放世界中自由选择前进的方向并塑造自己的命运。
  点燃火焰的远古力量，通过一段段残缺的故事拼凑出表面之下的真相。
   
  在迷雾中求得生存  游戏一开始，你唯一拥有的就是战胜荒野的不屈意志。在失落王国的遗迹中搜寻宝贵物资，竭尽所能击退意欲将你吞噬的凶猛野兽。
  穿越森林、洞穴与地牢，寻找隐秘的知识与宝藏。不断积累力量并最终深入迷雾，对抗来自深渊的可怕存在。
   
       
  激动人心的战斗  吞噬一切的迷雾将腐化被触及的所有存在，不断扭曲与操纵身处其中的万物生灵。披荆斩棘，战胜残忍的派系与可怕的Boss，对抗森林中的恶鬼，洞穴中的Vukah以及迷雾中的恐惧生物。
  闪躲、招架并埋伏你的敌人，运用意想不到的战技与强力法术。学会利用敌人的弱点，利用深入复杂的技能树系统培养出只属于你的独特游玩风格。
  
       
  打造史诗配置  重新唤醒大地的生命力！基于体素的建造系统将最大程度释放你的创造力，打造超乎想象的壮观建筑，随心所欲挑选琳琅满目的建筑材料与家具。但是在建造的过程中不要仅仅为自己考虑，游戏中的NPC角色将会向你寻求庇护，他们将为你解锁高级工坊以及打造史诗武器与护甲的能力。
  
       
   铸就传奇装备   打造并定制让人眼花缭乱的各类传奇武器与护甲，获取横扫千军的伟力。只有精通盾牌、刀剑、法杖与弓箭，你才能够抵挡住迷雾的无情推进。
  
       
   呼朋唤友   与好友们一同体验16名玩家的多人合作游戏。合理分配各自的身份并考虑技能互补，齐心协力斩妖除魔、收集宝藏并战胜肆虐大地的怪物。
  
       
   解开陨落王国的秘密   穿越薪谷的世界，从神秘的烬土沙漠到喧嚣森林的幽邃荫庇，领略栩栩如生的陨落文明与远古谜团。
  
  在迷雾深处，一个失落王国的遗迹之下埋藏着常人难以想象的故事，魔法、废墟、希望与救赎都在等待被发掘。

歡迎參與“亞洲內容創作者與主播招募”獲取支持與獎勵。點此查看詳情
  
     
 
 
  關於此遊戲  Embervale 已然陷落，你的祖先貪婪更多魔法力量，卻釋放出了吞噬世界的疫病。
  
  《Enshrouded》是一款帶有生存、製作與動作 RPG 戰鬥要素的遊戲，遊戲的舞台是一個以立體像素為基礎，草木蔓生的荒蕪大陸。隨著你跋山涉水穿過開放世界的群山與沙漠，你可以自由選擇你的目的地並掌握自己的命運。
  
  點燃遠古之火的力量，從線索中拼湊出呼之欲出的故事全貌吧。
  
   在 Shroud 之中存活   遊戲開始時，你一無所有，只有在荒野中生存下來的意志。你必須在失落王國的殘骸中尋找挖掘出能用的東西，並擊退意圖以你為食的野獸。
  
  穿越森林、洞穴、地下城，尋找祕密的知識與寶藏。讓自己變得更強，冒險進入 Shroud 之中，挑戰深淵中的恐怖怪物。
  
       
   血脈賁張的動作戰鬥   Shroud 會吞噬其腐蝕的大地，接觸到 Shroud 的生物都會發生突變，並受其支配。披荊斬棘，與四處破壞掠奪的集團和可怕的頭目戰鬥。在森林中與 Scavenger 戰鬥，在洞穴與 Vukah 拚搏，並在迷霧中打倒 Fell 生物。
  
  蹲下、格擋，並用意想之外的戰技與強大魔法讓對手措手不及。猛攻敵人的弱點，一邊用複雜精細的技能樹系統來開發屬於自己的獨特戰鬥方式。
  
       
   建造史詩建築   讓生命重現大地！以方塊為基礎的建築系統可以讓你盡情發揮創意，打造規模巨大的豪華建築，還能自由使用各式各樣的材料與家具。你的建築不只為自己而建，遊戲中的 NPC 也會找你尋求庇護，你也可以藉此解鎖進階的工作坊以及打造傳奇武器與盔甲的能力。
  
       
   打造傳奇戰士專屬的裝備   打造並自訂多得令人眼花撩亂的傳奇武器與盔甲，成為強大的戰士。要與無情的 Shroud 一戰，你必須掌握盾牌、長劍、法杖與弓箭的使用方法。
  
       
   呼朋引伴   與朋友一起進行最多 16 人的合作模式，塑造出屬於自己的角色定位與輔助技能，在與朋友一起突襲、尋寶、擊退四處破壞的 Fell 大軍，證明自己在戰鬥中的價值。
  
       
   解開失落國度之謎   在 Embervale 四處探索，從神祕的 Kindlewastes 沙漠到 Revelwood 黑暗的樹蔭之下，沉浸在如歷其境的失落文明以及古代傳說之中。
  
  在迷霧中以及失落王國的遺跡底下暗藏著一個充滿了魔法、毀滅、希望及救贖的故事，等著你去探索。

The realm of Embervale is lost. In their greed for magical power, your ancestors unleashed a pestilence that consumed the world.
  
  Enshrouded is a game of survival, crafting, and Action RPG combat, set within a sprawling voxel-based continent. As you journey across the mountains and deserts of an open world, you are free to choose your path and shape your destiny.
  
  Ignite the Ancient power of the Flame, and piece together the fragments of a story that unfolds below the surface.
  
   SURVIVE THE SHROUD  
 You start with nothing but the will to survive the wilds. You must scrape and scavenge through the ruined remnants of a lost kingdom, and fend off the beasts that hunger for your flesh.
  
  Journey through forests, caves, dungeons, searching for secret knowledge and treasure. Build the strength to venture into the Shroud and bring the fight back to the horrors of the deep.
  
       
   HEART POUNDING ACTION COMBAT   
The Shroud consumes the land it corrupts, mutating and guiding all life it encounters. Cleave your way through ravaging factions and formidable bosses, battling Scavenger in the forests, Vukah in the caves, and Fell creatures in the mist.
  
  Duck, parry, and surprise your foes with unexpected fighting skills and powerful spells. Exploit the weaknesses of your enemies as you develop your own unique playstyle with an in-depth skill tree system.
  
       
   CREATE EPIC BUILDS  
 Bring life back to the land! Voxel-based building unleashes your creative vision, allowing you to create grand architecture on an epic scale, customized with a vast assortment of materials and furniture. Build not only for yourself, because NPCs will take refuge within your walls, unlocking advanced workshops and the ability to craft epic weapons and armor.
  
       
   CRAFT GEAR WORTHY OF LEGEND   
Craft and customize a staggering array of legendary weapons and armor to become a force to be reckoned with. You'll need to master the shield, the sword, the staff and the bow to withstand the merciless advance of the Shroud.
  
       
   CALL UPON YOUR ALLIES   Join with friends in 16 player co-op gameplay. Carve out unique roles and complimentary skills that will prove your worth in battle as together you raid, gather treasure, and overcome the Fell hordes that ravage the land.
  
       
   UNLOCK THE SECRETS OF A FALLEN REALM   
Journey through the biomes of Embervale to immerse yourself in vibrant fallen cultures and ancient myths, from the mystical desert of the Kindlewastes to the dark canopies of The Revelwood.
  
  Within the fog, and beneath the ruins of a lost kingdom lies an ever-unfolding story of magic, ruin, hope, and redemption waiting to be discovered.

El reino de Embervale se ha caído en ruinas. En su deseo por poder, vuestros ancestros liberaron una plaga que consumió el mundo.
  
  Enshrouded es un juego de supervivencia, fabricación y combate estilo RPG ambientado en un enorme continente diseñado a partir de vóxeles. Cuando recorráis explores las montañas y desiertos de este mundo abierto, podréis elegir vuestro propio camino y modelar vuestro destino.
  
  Encended el poder ancestral de la Llama y recomponed los fragmentos de una historia que se esconde bajo la superficie.
  
   SOBREVIVIR AL SHROUD   
Al empezar solo contaréis con vuestro instinto de supervivencia. Tendréis que saquear y rebuscar entre los restos de un reino perdido y defenderos de las bestias que intentarán devoraros.
  
  Recorred bosques, cuevas y mazmorras en busca de tesoros y conocimientos secretos. Preparaos para adentraros en el Shroud y enfrentaros contra los horrores que acechan en su interior.

       
   COMBATE CON ACCIÓN TREPIDANTE   
El Shroud consume los territorios que corrompe, haciendo mutar a todas las formas de vida que encuentra a su paso. Enfrentaos a facciones de saqueadores y a formidables jefes, luchad contra los enemigos que se ocultan en los bosques, los vukah de las cuevas y las criaturas letales que acechan en la niebla.
  
  Esquivad, bloquead y sorprended a vuestros enemigos con habilidades de combate inesperadas y potentes hechizos. Aprovechad las debilidades de vuestros contrincantes mientras desarrolláis vuestro estilo de juego personal gracias al elaborado sistema del árbol de habilidades.
  
       
   EDIFICIOS ALUCINANTES   ¡Devolved la vida a los territorios! Las posibilidades de construcción mediante vóxeles permiten crear arquitecturas majestuosas a una escala descomunal y personalizarlas con gran cantidad de materiales y mobiliario. Los PNJ también podrán refugiarse en vuestras construcciones para desbloquear talleres avanzados y la capacidad de crear armas y armaduras épicas.
  
       
   EQUIPAMIENTO DIGNO DE UNA LEYENDA   
Cread y personalizad una enorme cantidad de armas y armaduras de leyenda y convertíos en un enemigo digno que tener en cuenta. Deberéis dominar el escudo, la espada, el bastón y el arco para poder plantar cara al implacable avance del Shroud.
  
       
   CONVOCA VUESTROS ALIADOS   
Uníos a vuestros amigos en partidas cooperativas hasta 16 jugadores. Ocupad puestos especiales y usad habilidades complementarias para demostrar vuestra valía en combate al asaltar, saquear tesoros y aplastar a las hordas letales que asolan el continente.
  
       
   DESCUBRE LOS SECRETOS DE UN REINO CAÍDO   
Recorred los biomas de Embervale para sumergiros en vibrantes culturas caídas y en mitos ancestrales, desde el desierto místico de Kindlewastes hasta la oscura espesura de Revelwood.
  
  En la niebla y bajo las ruinas de un reino perdido subyace una historia llena de misterios, magia, ruina, esperanzas y redención que está esperando a ser desvelada.

Le royaume d'Embervale est perdu. Dans leur avidité de pouvoir magique, vos ancêtres ont déclenché un fléau qui a ravagé le monde.
  
  Enshrouded est un jeu de survie, de craft, et de combat action-RPG qui se déroule sur un vaste continent en voxels. En traversant les montagnes et les déserts d'un monde ouvert, vous serez libre de choisir votre chemin et de forger votre destin.
  
  Ravivez l'ancien pouvoir de la flamme et rassemblez les fragments d'une histoire qui se déroule sous la surface.
  
   SURVIVRE AU VOILE   
Vous ne commencez avec rien d'autre que la volonté de survivre dans la nature. Vous devez fouiller les ruines d'un royaume perdu et repousser les bêtes qui ont faim de votre chair.
  
  Voyagez à travers les forêts, les grottes et les donjons, à la recherche de connaissances secrètes et de trésors. Développez la force nécessaire pour vous aventurer dans le Shroud et combattre les horreurs des profondeurs.
  
       
   COMBAT D'ACTION PALPITANT  
 Le Voile consume les terres qu'il corrompt, mutant et guidant toute vie qu'il rencontre. Frayez-vous un chemin à travers des factions ravageuses et des boss redoutables, en affrontant les Démons dans les forêts, les Vukah dans les cavernes et les créatures déchues dans la brume.
  
  Esquivez, parez et surprenez vos ennemis avec des compétences de combat inattendues et des sorts puissants. Exploitez les faiblesses de vos ennemis et développez votre propre style de jeu grâce à un arbre de compétences approfondi.
  
       
   CRÉEZ DES CONSTRUCTIONS ÉPIQUES   
Redonnez vie à la terre ! La construction basée sur le voxel libère votre vision créative, vous permettant de créer une architecture grandiose à une échelle épique, personnalisée avec un vaste assortiment de matériaux et d’objets. Construisez non seulement pour vous, mais aussi pour les PNJ qui se réfugieront dans vos murs, débloquant ainsi des ateliers avancés et la possibilité de fabriquer des armes et des armures épiques.
  
       
   FABRIQUEZ DES OBJETS LÉGENDAIRES   
Fabriquez et personnalisez une gamme impressionnante d'armes et d'armures légendaires pour devenir une force avec laquelle il faut compter. Vous devrez maîtriser le bouclier, l'épée, le bâton et l'arc pour résister à l'avancée impitoyable du Voile.
  
       
   FAITES APPEL À VOS ALLIÉS   Rejoignez vos amis dans un jeu en coop à 16 joueurs. Définissez des rôles uniques et des compétences complémentaires qui prouveront votre valeur au combat. Ensemble, vous mènerez des pillages, récolterez des trésors et vaincrez les hordes déchues qui ravagent le pays.
  
       
   PERCEZ LES SECRETS D'UN ROYAUME DÉCHU   
Voyagez à travers les biomes d'Embervale pour vous immerger dans les vibrantes cultures disparues et les mythes anciens, du désert mystique des Kindlewastes aux sombres canopées du Revelwood.
  
  Dans le brouillard et sous les ruines d'un royaume perdu se cache une histoire de magie, de ruine, d'espoir et de rédemption qui ne demande qu'à être découverte.

Das Reich Embervale ist verloren. In ihrer Gier nach magischer Kraft haben deine Vorfahren eine Seuche freigesetzt, welche die Welt vernichtet hat.
  
  Enshrouded ist ein Spiel, in dem es ums Überleben und Herstellen geht, ein Action-RPG-Kampfspiel, das sich auf einem weitläufigen voxelbasierten Kontinent abspielt. Auf deiner Reise durch die Berge und Wüsten dieser offenen Welt kannst du deinen Weg frei wählen und dein eigenes Schicksal formen.
  
  Entzünde die alte Macht der Flamme und füge die Fragmente einer Geschichte zusammen, die sich unter der Oberfläche entfaltet.
  
   ÜBERLEBE DEN SHROUD   
Am Anfang hast du nichts außer deinen Willen, in der Wildnis zu überleben. Du musst dich durch die verfallenen Reste eines verlorenen Königreichs kämpfen und die Bestien abwehren, die es auf dein Fleisch abgesehen haben.
  
  Durchquere Wälder, Höhlen, Verliese, suche nach geheimem Wissen und Schätzen. Werde stärker, um dich in den Shroud zu wagen und den Kampf zu den Schrecken der Tiefe zurückzubringen.
  
       
   ATEMBERAUBENDE KAMPF-ACTION   
Der Shroud breitet sich über das Land aus, in das er Verderben bringt, wobei er jedes Leben, das ihm begegnet mutieren lässt und hörig macht. Bahne deinen Weg durch zerstörerische Horden und mächtige Bosse, bekämpfe Plünderer in den Wäldern, Vukah in den Höhlen und tödliche Kreaturen im Nebel.
  
  Weiche aus, pariere und überrasche deine Gegner mit unerwarteten Kampffertigkeiten und mächtigen Zaubern. Erforsche die Schwächen deiner Feinde und entwickle deinen eigenen einzigartigen Spielstil anhand eines detaillierten Skill-Baumsystems.
  
       
   ERSCHAFFE EPISCHE BAUTEN  
 Bringe das Leben in das Land zurück! Beim Voxel-basierten Bauen kannst du deine kreative Vision entfalten, prachtvolle Architektur von epischen Maßstäben erschaffen und diese mithilfe einer riesigen Auswahl von Materialien und Möbeln individuell ausgestalten. Baue nicht nur für dich selbst, denn NPCs werden bei dir Zuflucht suchen. Schalte fortgeschrittene Werkstätten und die Fähigkeit frei, epische Waffen und Rüstung herzustellen.
  
       
   STELLE LEGENDÄRE AUSRÜSTUNG HER   
Stelle ein überwältigendes Sortiment von legendären Waffen und Rüstung her und verbessere sie individuell, um über deine Grenzen hinauszuwachsen. Du musst den Schild, das Schwert, den Stab und den Bogen beherrschen, um dich dem gnadenlosen Vormarsch des Shrouds entgegenzustellen.
  
       
   RUFE DEINE VERBÜNDETEN   Spiele mit Freunden im 16-Spieler-Koop-Gameplay. Arbeite einzigartige Rollen und ergänzende Fertigkeiten heraus, mit denen du dich im Kampf bewähren wirst, wenn du gemeinsam mit anderen auf Feldzüge gehst, Schätze sammelst und die grausamen Horden bezwingst, die das Land verwüsten.
  
       
   SCHALTE DIE GEHEIMNISSE EINES GEFALLENEN REICHS FREI   
Reise durch die Biome von Embervale und tauche in pulsierende gefallene Kulturen und urzeitliche Mythen ein – von der geheimnisvollen Wüste von Kindlewastes bis hin zu den dunklen Wipfel von Revelwood.
  
  Im Nebel und unterhalb der Ruinen eines verlorenen Königreichs befindet sich eine kontinuierlich fortschreibende Geschichte, die von Magie, Zerfall, Hoffnung und Erlösung erzählt und darauf wartet, entdeckt zu werden.

アジアクリエイター及びインフルエンサー募集プロジェクトに参加しポイントとボーナスを獲得しよう！詳細はこちら！
  
     
 
 
  ゲームについて  失われた王国、エンバーベール。魔法の力に目がくらんだ先人たちによって世界は伝染病に侵された。
  
  『Enshrouded』はボクセルアートの大陸を舞台にサバイバル、クラフト、戦闘が繰り広げられるアクションRPG。オープンワールドの山々や砂漠を探索しながら、自らの道を自由に選択して運命を切り開け。
  
  古代の力の炎を燃やし、断片をつなぎ合わせて水面下で展開する物語を解き明かそう。
  
   Shroudを生き抜け   開始時点で与えられたものは、荒野を生き抜く意志のみ。廃墟と化した失われた王国で資源をあさり、かき集めながら、血肉を求める飢えたケダモノたちを撃退しなければならない。
  
  隠された情報や秘宝を求めて、森や洞窟、地下牢を探索。体を鍛えてShroudの内部に歩を進めて、深部の恐怖に立ち向かえ。
  
       
   ドキドキのアクションと戦闘   シュラウドは土地を飲み込んで汚染し、包み込んだ生き物をすべて変異させ支配する。破壊的な敵や手強いボス勢と戦いながら突き進み、森の悪霊、洞窟のVukah、 そして霧の中のクリーチャー、フェルとの戦闘に挑め。
  
  敵の攻撃をかわし、戦闘スキルや強力な呪文で敵の不意を突こう。奥の深いスキルツリーシステムで自分だけのプレイスタイルを追求して、敵の弱点に付け込め。
  
       
   壮大な建造物を構築   この地に再び活力を！ボクセルアートの建築でクリエイティブな才能を発揮して、膨大な種類の材料や家具でカスタマイズした壮大なスケールの立派な建築物を作り出そう。ただし、構築した建物を使うのは自分だけではない。建てた家にNPCが逃げ込んでくれば、進化した作業場や、高いレベルの武器や防具をクラフトできる能力が入手可能になる。
  
       
   レジェンドにふさわしい武器をクラフト   一目置かれる存在になりたいなら、驚くほど豊富な種類の武器や防具をクラフトしてカスタマイズしよう。盾、剣、杖、弓をマスターしなければ、シュラウドの容赦なき進行には抵抗できない。
  
       
   仲間を招集   16人と協力プレイを楽しもう。それぞれの役割やスキルを担当して、共に戦い、宝物を集め、この国を破壊するフェルに打ち勝て。
  
       
   壊滅状態の王国に秘められた謎を解明   エンバーベールの生物群系を探索して、キンドルウェイストの神秘的な砂漠からレベルウッドの暗い森まで、破滅しても今なお色褪せない文化と古代の神話に没入しよう。
  
  霧の中、そして失われた王国の廃墟の下には、魔法、堕落、希望、そして贖罪の変わらぬ物語が明るみに出るその日を待っている。

title: Patchwork
description:
In Patchwork, two players compete to build the most aesthetic (and high-scoring) patchwork quilt on a personal 9x9 game board. To start play, lay out all of the patches at random in a circle and place a marker directly clockwise of the 2-1 patch. Each player takes five buttons — the currency/points in the game — and someone is chosen as the start player.

On a turn, a player either purchases one of the three patches standing clockwise of the spool or passes. To purchase a patch, you pay the cost in buttons shown on the patch, move the spool to that patch's location in the circle, add the patch to your game board, then advance your time token on the time track a number of spaces equal to the time shown on the patch. You're free to place the patch anywhere on your board that doesn't overlap other patches, but you probably want to fit things together as tightly as possible. If your time token is behind or on top of the other player's time token, then you take another turn; otherwise the opponent now goes. Instead of purchasing a patch, you can choose to pass; to do this, you move your time token to the space immediately in front of the opponent's time token, then take one button from the bank for each space you moved.

In addition to a button cost and time cost, each patch also features 0-3 buttons, and when you move your time token past a button on the time track, you earn "button income": sum the number of buttons depicted on your personal game board, then take this many buttons from the bank.

What's more, the time track depicts five 1x1 patches on it, and during set-up you place five actual 1x1 patches on these spaces. Whoever first passes a patch on the time track claims this patch and immediately places it on his game board.

Additionally, the first player to completely fill in a 7x7 square on his game board earns a bonus tile worth 7 extra points at the end of the game. (Of course, this doesn't happen in every game.)

When a player takes an action that moves his time token to the central square of the time track, he takes one final button income from the bank. Once both players are in the center, the game ends and scoring takes place. Each player scores one point per button in his possession, then loses two points for each empty square on his game board. Scores can be negative. The player with the most points wins.

If your time token is behind or on top of the other player's time token, then you take another turn; otherwise the opponent now goes. Instead of purchasing a patch, you can choose to pass; to do this, you move your time token to the space immediately in front of the opponent's time token, then take one button from the bank for each space you moved.

In addition to a button cost and time cost, each patch also features 0-3 buttons, and when you move your time token past a button on the time track, you earn "button income": sum the number of buttons depicted on your personal game board, then take this many buttons from the bank.

What's more, the time track depicts five 1x1 patches on it, and during set-up you place five actual 1x1 patches on these spaces. Whoever first passes a patch on the time track claims this patch and immediately places it on his game board.

Additionally, the first player to completely fill in a 7x7 square on his game board earns a bonus tile worth 7 extra points at the end of the game. (Of course, this doesn't happen in every game.)

When a player takes an action that moves his time token to the central square of the time track, he takes one final button income from the bank. Once both players are in the center, the game ends and scoring takes place. Each player scores one point per button in his possession, then loses two points for each empty square on his game board. Scores can be negative. The player with the most points wins.

title: Cozy Cat Cafe
description:
Cozy Cat Cafe is a tile placing game, and players need to strategically place their cats and furniture in the right position to entice the customers and gain extra points by bringing ambience into the cafe. Players will compete to be the first to attract big spenders, shake things up by activating cat abilities, and pull off perfect combos to transform their cafe with maximum ambience.

Each player starts with an empty Cozy Cat Cafe, gathering resources over a total of 3 rounds, each with 9 turns.

Players take turns to either adopt cats, buy furniture, or invite customers into their cafe. Adopting cats will cost you cookies, but allow you to play cat cards; buying furniture will cost you coins, but inviting the customers will bring you resources as well as points.

Cozy Cat Cafe has 16 goal tiles for different bonus combinations each game and a variety of different customer cards for increased variability.

title: 12 Memory Lane
description:
12 Memory Lane is a first-person narrative mystery game. Step inside the  manor of the elusive Henry Villemaine and piece together the slices of life leading up to the sudden disappearance of his family.
  EXPLORE AN EVER-SHIFTING MANSION  Henry Villemaine’s mansion is constantly shifting : faces change in photographs, furniture moves when you’re not looking... Use post-it notes to mark objects and keep them fixed in place as you explore.
  RECREATE SCENES FROM A FRAGMENTED JOURNAL  Henry’s personal journal is your only trustworthy guide. Through its pages, relive intimate moments of family life and interpret his memories to restore each room, deducing the correct placement of furniture and objects.
  UNCOVER UNSPOKEN FAMILY SECRETS  Every room holds the silent truth of a member of the Villemaine family. Set the mansion right to reveal long-buried secrets… and uncover whether your role in this mystery is more than that of a simple investigator.

title: Hearing Voices
description:
Hearing Voices is a short horror puzzle experience about listening for clues in audio tapes and piecing them together to figure out the message.  
  
You play as Luis Edno, a highly qualified audio analyst. You will need to rely on your ears and problem solving skills to decipher heavily scrambled communications from the enemy. But the tapes are hiding something else.
        
 Listen Closely 
  You heard something different in the tape. Was it static? Was it a voice? Or were your ears playing tricks on you?        
  
   Decipher The Message 
  Did the voice say 'someone', 'summon' or 'salmon'? What message were they trying to send?
   
   Avoid Paranoia 
  You can't brute force anything at this desk. Every mistake you make sends you further into paranoia. 
  
 Immerse yourself in a dark, creepy aesthetic with hand-drawn art. Solve unique audio-based puzzles. Experience the thrill of going through terrifyingly creepy audio tapes while trying to focus on the message hidden underneath the terror. Embrace yourself for this unique, tightly paced audio horror experience.
